newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Deutsche Bank launches warrants on Air NZ 'B' shrs.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank launches warrants on Air NZ 'B' shrs.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday it would launch warrants on Air New Zealand 'B' ordinary shares, which are available to both onshore and offshore investors.

"This latest series enables an investor to buy one B ordinary share of Air NZ upon exercise of four warrants and payment of NZ$4.80 per share at any time up to May 25, 1999," Deutsche Bank said through the global coordinator of the issue, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities.

"The Air NZ B warrant differs from previous warrant issues in that four warrants are required upon exercise (existing issues have conversion ratios of either two for one or one for one) and the expiry date of May 25, 1999, will give this warrant the longest term to expiry."
The warrants would be quoted for normal trading from July 21.
